column3: “on each altar” renders “on the altar” (also in verses 4, 14 and 30).
“a bare hill” renders “shefi,” a bare height.
“his discourse” renders “his mashal (oracle, saying)” (also in verse 18).
“As I see him” renders “for from the top … I see him,” and “shall not be reckoned” renders “does not reckon itself.”
“the fourth part” renders a word (rova) that may mean “dust cloud,” so the meaning is uncertain; “Let me die” renders “let my soul die.”
“you have actually blessed them” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
“the extreme end of them” renders “its outskirts.”
NASB supplies “the LORD” and renders “thus” as “yonder.”
“repent” renders “change his mind (niham),” and “make it good” renders “fulfill (raise) it.”
“I have received a command to bless” renders “I have received to bless,” and “I cannot revoke it” renders “I will not turn it back.”
“the wild ox” renders “re’em,” an animal whose identity is uncertain (also in 24:8).
“against Jacob” and “against Israel” render “in Jacob” and “in Israel,” and “At the proper time” renders “about this time.”
“at all” renders two emphatic doubled verbs.
“it will be agreeable with God” renders “it will be right in the eyes of God.”
